temporal_scope.note: Each user's own history is split chronologically, so no user's future leaks into their training data. Across users the folds overlap in wall-clock time: one user's training review can be later than another user's test review. This is the standard leave-last-one-out protocol; a single global cut-off date would be a different and stricter setting, and is not used here.

relevance.definition: implicit next-item: the chronologically next hotel the user reviewed
relevance.note: Ratings are not thresholded by default; the holdout item is relevant because it was visited, not because it scored well.
